behavioral.text: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate. How did you handle it?
Tell me about a project that didn't go as planned. What happened, and what did you do?
Describe a time you led something without having formal authority.
Tell me about a time the requirements were unclear. How did you move forward?
Tell me about a time you had more work than you could finish. How did you decide what to drop?
Tell me about some critical feedback you received and what you did with it.
Describe a time you changed someone's mind about an important decision.
good_answer_covers: the evidence or approach they used

behavioral.text: Tell me about a time you had to deliver under a tight deadline.
Tell me about something you had to learn quickly to get a job done.
Tell me about a time you noticed a problem that wasn't your job to fix. What did you do?
Tell me about a mistake you made that affected other people.
What's the piece of work you're proudest of, and why?

technical.text: Walk me through how you'd break down a big, vague problem into something you can start on this week.
How would you decide between two reasonable options when you only have part of the data?
good_answer_covers: what extra data is worth getting

technical.text: If you changed a process at work, how would you know whether the change actually helped?
Explain something complex from your field as if I had no background in it.

behavioral.text: Tell me about a technical decision you disagreed with. What did you do?

behavioral.text: Tell me about a time you helped another engineer level up.
